# Lu documentation index

Lu is a small job queue for finite coding-agent work against git repositories. The `lu` binary is
the controller and operator CLI; `ting` is the node agent. Start with README.md for the quickstart
and command list.

- [README](README.md): overview, quickstart, commands, limits and docs links.
- [AGENTS](AGENTS.md): build, test, lint and repository conventions for contributors.
- [Security policy](SECURITY.md): private vulnerability reporting and supported versions.
- [Changelog](CHANGELOG.md): released changes.
- [Quickstart](docs/quickstart.md): ten-minute one-machine walkthrough with expected output.
- [Install](docs/install.md): release archives, source builds and service layout.
- [Configuration](docs/config.md): every config table, validation rule and examples.
- [Operations](docs/operations.md): upgrade, rollback, backup, restore and fleet changes.
- [Security](docs/security.md): tokens, TLS, intake signing and the controller boundary.
- [Limits](docs/limits.md): what Lu does not protect against and fail-open cases.
- [Troubleshooting](docs/troubleshooting.md): exact errors and the checks that fix them.
- [HTTP API](docs/api.md): routes, request and response shapes.
- [ting reference](docs/ting.md): node agent CLI and exit codes.
- [Architecture concepts](docs/concepts.md): jobs, nodes, leases and artifacts.
- [Job lifecycle](docs/lifecycle.md): states and transitions.
- [Dependencies](docs/dependencies.md): chaining, collection and blocked dependents.
- [Batch submissions](docs/batch.md): directory and checklist batch planning.
- [Drafts](docs/drafts.md): signed intake proposals and approval.
- [Publishing](docs/publish.md): publishing a finished diff.
- [Workspaces](docs/workspaces.md): checkout staging and workspace policies.
- [Dispatch](docs/dispatch.md): labels, taints, providers and placement.
- [Monitoring](docs/monitoring.md): metrics and node contribution statistics.
- [Audit record](docs/audit.md): hash chain, verification and anchoring.
- [Tokens and TLS](docs/tokens-and-tls.md): file rules, rotation and transport security.
- [Security scanning](docs/security-scanning.md): workflows and release verification.
- [Compatibility](docs/compatibility.md): wire rules and release update order.
- [Client guide](docs/client-guide.md): operator CLI and MCP client usage.
- [MCP server](docs/mcp.md): operator tools and the scoped harness server.
- [opencode harness](docs/opencode-harness.md): harness setup and provider credentials.
- [Reiki](docs/reiki.md): provider health and cordon behaviour.
- [Worked examples](docs/examples.md): end-to-end task examples.
- [Intake](docs/intake.md): signed webhook intake rules.
- [Adding a node](docs/onboarding-nodes.md): node onboarding steps.
- [Ting migration](docs/migration-ting.md): upgrading an existing agent host.
- [Scope](docs/scope.md): audit scope and boundaries.
- [Container scope](docs/scope-container.md): container deployment scope.
- [Ansible scope](docs/scope-ansible.md): Ansible deployment scope.
- [FAQ](docs/faq.md): common questions.
- [Agent self-drain notes](NOTES.md): operator and agent drain coordination.
